meta.time_precision: 24 fps resample; every time in this analysis is approximate within 1/24 s (0.0417 s). Nothing here is a recovered keyframe or a source ease.
meta.presentation_chrome: none - the full 1280x720 frame is the film (no editor, slide or device mock on the overview or any c-sheet)
meta.use_when: A 25 s product ad on a dark bed with a fixed lens and two travelled arrivals: cards that resolve soft-to-sharp in place and type their own text, a colour sweep into a product macro that pulls back to a yawed wide card, word-pop headlines that mature from accent green to white, glitch-scramble word swaps with grey placeholder blocks, and a static photo end card.

do_not: Exact replica: do not add camera glides, re-aims, pushes or settles the reference never had. The lens moves twice (9.75 settle, 11.04 pull); every other framing change is a 1-frame cut or a soft resolve in place.
Do not crossfade any seam. No join here is a crossfade or a dip; softness is on the incoming side only, and the outgoing gets at most a 1-2-frame blur pulse.
Do not build the card growth, tilt, drift or the chips' convergence as camera zoom - they are object motion on a fixed lens.
Do not let headline words arrive white; they land in the accent green and cool to white ~0.35 s later.
Do not fade the end-card lockup up from transparent - it is on the photo from the cut's first frame in dark teal and ramps to white; do not zoom the photo (it is static).
Do not add a cursor approach: the pointer is already parked on the button when the card resolves and never moves; no cursor exists after 2.6.

Do not replace the glitch swaps with a plain crossfade or slide: they are symbol scrambles re-rolling every ~2 frames with a grey block covering a word for 1-3 frames; the second swap is longer (0.83 s) than the first (0.46 s).
Do not carry the 29.97 -> 24 fps jitter (repeated/dropped frames) into a build; timings here are +-1/24 s.
Do not copy the reference's copy, logo, product UI or photo - technique only.
evidence_rules: Every seam and landing cites sheet + tile(s). A row with evidence:[] is a guess, carries confidence:"low", and is flagged by validate-spec.mjs. Sheet ids: c-NNN (4 fps composition, tiles 1-30), f-NNN (24 fps full, tiles 1-48), w-<t> (24 fps strip, tiles 1-N per windows/index.json), overview (cells 1-24). Tile numbers are per sheet: tile = badge frame - 30 x (sheet - 1) on c-sheets, - 48 x (sheet - 1) on f-sheets; map.txt resolves any cell. note fields are allowed on every row and are rendered in the briefs.
